name: ampersend
description: Control layer for agent spending over x402: agent wallets with budgets, spending limits, seller allowlists and audit trails, plus a CLI and SDK for MCP and A2A payments. By Edge & Node.

skills.name: Hold Funds in Agent Wallet
skills.description: Creates or imports an agent wallet funded with USDC on Base, with auto top-ups from the main account.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Sets per-transaction, daily and monthly limits and seller allowlists that every agent payment is checked against.

skills.name: Pay with x402
skills.description: Pays x402-enabled MCP tools, A2A agents and HTTP APIs through the SDK's payment-aware clients and MCP proxy.

skills.name: Sell Paid Endpoints
skills.description: Turns an OpenAPI spec into paid hosted endpoints and manages them from the ampersend CLI.
